paragraphs: Apptegy sells a communications platform to K-12 school districts, gathering the tools and training that district staff use to reach families. The pitch to district leaders is that the school brand stays at the front of every message.

Districts get a branded website managed through a drag-and-drop editor with page permissions for contributors and analytics. A district-branded mobile app for iOS and Android carries school information and two-way messaging for families. Alerts go out by email, push notification, SMS, text-to-speech, voice call and social media from one place. Automated translation is offered for more than 100 languages, and websites are built to meet WCAG 2.1 A and AA standards.

The home page states that 5,273 districts have switched to the platform for their communications. Beyond software the company publishes SchoolCEO magazine, with guides and original research for district leaders. One study listed there was done jointly with NSPRA on the relationship between superintendents and school communicators.

quote.text: 5,273 districts have switched to Apptegy to power their communications.
